en:
Increases maximum influence a little.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Envious Influence.

Increases maximum influence a lot.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Attentive Influence.

Increases maximum focus a little.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Menacing Focus.

Increases maximum focus a lot.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Extraordinary Focus.

Slightly increases the time limit in 
each phase. Effective during all
parts of the class trial.

Increases amount of influence recovered
by right answers. Effective during 
Nonstop Debates and choices.

Makes the reticle shake less. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates. 
Can't be combined with Tranquility.

Makes the reticle stop shaking. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates. 
Can't be combined with Cool and Composed.

Slows the speed of the reticle. 
Effective during Nonstop Debates. 
Can't be combined with Upshift.

Increases the speed of the reticle.
Effective during Nonstop Debates.
Can't be combined with Downshift.

Increases the speed of fired Truth
Bullets. Efffective during Nonstop
and Mass Panic Debates.

Decreases the delay after using Truth
Bullets or Truth Blades. Effective during
Nonstop, Mass Panic, & Rebuttal Showdown.

After enough time, the correct Truth Bullet
will be shown. Effective during Nonstop,
Mass Panic Debates, & Rebuttal Showdowns.

While concentrating, the reticle will 
automatically move over weak points.
Effective during Nonstop Debates.

Increases maximum influence a little.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Envious Influence.

The Focus Gauge drains slower while
Concentrating and during Fever Time. 
Effective during all parts of the class trial.

Slowly recovers the Influence Gauge while
Concentrating and during Fever Time.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.

Increases the recovery speed of the
Focus Gauge. Effective during all
parts of the class trial.

Increases the amount of Monocoins
obtained after class trials.

Makes Truth Bullets penetrate white
noise. Effective during Nonstop and
Mass Panic Debates.

Makes the Silencer fire rapidly. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates.
Can't be combined with Shotgun or Grenade.

The Silencer shoots bigger shots. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates. Can't
be combined with Machine Gun or Grenade.

Hold to shoot a strong Silencer. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates. Can't
be combined with Machine Gun or Shotgun.

Allows the <PAD=【Ｆ㊧】> to be used to 
destroy white noise. Is effective during
Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates.

The reticle will lock on to nearby V 
Points while Concentrating. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates.

Influence drains slower while a Lie
Bullet is loaded. Effective during
Nonstop Debates.

Reveals V Points. Effective during 
Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates.

Silences all conversations except those
the reticle is on. Effective during Mass
Panic Debates.

Instantly silences loud voices. Effective
during Mass Panic Debates.

The key word in the first speaker's 
argument will be shown from the start.
Effective during Debate Scrums.

Makes it easier to push the opponent
back during the Final Push. Effective
during Debate Scrums.

The entire screen will light up more
frequently. Effective during Hangman's
Gambit Ver3.0.

The first letter will be filled in from
the beginning. Effective during 
Hangman's Gambit Ver3.0.

The flash spot will instantly grow to 
full size. Effective during Hangman's
Gambit Ver3.0.

Increases the amount of letter cubes
that can be acquired at once.
Effective during Psyche Taxi.

Switches to a better car with higher
top speed and better acceleration. 
Effective during Psyche Taxi.

Reduces the shock when an
obstacle is hit. Effective during
Psyche Taxi.

Makes it easier to push the opponent
back during Blade Lock. Effective
during Rebuttal Showdowns.

Increases the size of slashes.
Effective during Rebuttal Showdowns.

Lets the cursor move freely, no matter
how far the opponent has pushed.
Effective during Rebuttal Showdowns.

Removes the time penalty for breaking
a non-erasable piece. Effective during
Imagination Excavation.

Some of the pieces will be missing
from the beginning. Effective during
Imagination Excavation.

Once part of an object becomes visible,
the entire object will be shown. 
Effective during Imagination Excavation.

The Tension Gauge will increase at
a faster rate. Effective during 
Argument Armament.

Makes the beats easier to hit.
Effective during Argument Armament.

Increases critical damage.
Effective during Argument Armament.

Some panels will be filled in from the
beginning. Effective during the 
Closing Argument.

Allows you to undo your last action
with <PAD=【×】>. Effective during 
Imagination Excavation.

Allows the rear touch pad to be used to 
destroy white noise. Is effective during
Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates.
